ngaap.guidance: Release gives no numeric guidance ('we expect 2009 to be a difficult year'). 2008 10-K: 2009 effective tax rate ~26%; additional pretax restructuring costs $40-60m in 2009; restructuring savings >$100m recurring pretax in 2009; 2009 intangible amortization ~$146m.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted net EPS from continuing operations: excludes Tektronix inventory / deferred-revenue fair-value charges ($59.5m pretax FY), Q4-08 restructuring and related charges ($82.0m pretax; release label; 10-K table 81,965 thousand) and net tax-reserve reductions / discrete tax benefits; amortization NOT added back. Adjusted net earnings from continuing ops 1,414.1. Prior-year adjusted EPS 3.83 (unchanged definition). Q4-08: adjusted EPS 1.11, core growth -1.0%. Release has no FCF table; CFO from continuing ops $1.9bn (+9.5%). Restructuring charges are inside COGS (33.1) and SG&A (48.8), not a separate IS line.
